title: 2621 NORTH JOHNSTON STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260081
text:
[C. PUBLIC NUISANCE HEARINGS regarding the abatement of vacant buildings or structures that are]
2621 NORTH JOHNSTON STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260081
  C.D.: 1 (Councilmember Eunisses Hernandez); North East Los Angeles Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Zeydi Stewart
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Code Enforcement/Vacant Building Abatement

  OWNER:  Francisco Gonzalez & Kathy Dominguez

  SUBJECT:

  The Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) requests that the Board of Building and
  Safety Commissioners (BBSC) determine that the subject property, a fire-damaged, one-story,
  single-family, that is continually breached and left open to unauthorized entry, constitutes a public
  nuisance.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS NOT APPEALABLE.
